profile.headline: Manager, Product Management at Mastercard
profile.summary:
"I hold both an MBA and a Master of Arts in Management and Leadership from Webster University, completed in 2019. This dual master's level education equips me with a comprehensive understanding of business strategy, organizational leadership, and effective management practices, which I apply to my diverse professional background. My work experience has afforded me many opportunities to work with various projects, from survey design and administration at Maritz on the American Express project, to the data warehouse at Centene working with their IVR product, to MasterCard BPMS applications which includes integration with nearly every core team at MasterCard. I have worked in roles of Account Management, Team Lead, Tech Lead, Customer Service, Sales, and have fulfilled many other roles as well. I also hold a BA in Software Engineering and an AS in Software Programming from ITT. My goal is to provide leadership for my company to improve decision making, provide connections between key resources in technology and business to provide the best strategies for leadership, employee development, and development of new and existing products."

Specialties: Include but are not limited to Process Architecture, Business Process Management Solutions, Software Development, Customer Service, Sales and Account Management.

positions.title: Manager, Product Management
positions.description:
As Manager of Product Management within Mastercard’s Transaction Fraud & Decisioning team, I lead the strategy and execution of fraud data ingestion across global platforms. I own the end-to-end process for collecting, validating, and reporting fraud data, enabling Mastercard and its partners to make informed, data-driven decisions that mitigate risk and enhance transaction security.

My role bridges product innovation and operational excellence, collaborating cross-functionally with engineering, data science, and client-facing teams to deliver scalable solutions that support real-time fraud detection, regulatory compliance, and performance insights.

Key responsibilities include:
-Driving roadmap and delivery for fraud data ingestion pipelines.
-Managing data integrity and reporting across internal and external stakeholders.
-Partnering with Support Services Organization (SSO) and global fraud teams to align on data governance and reporting standards.
-Translating complex fraud trends into actionable product features and enhancements.

I’m passionate about building resilient, data-centric products that protect consumers and empower issuers, acquirers, and merchants worldwide.

positions.title: Senior Analyst Customer Technical Services
positions.description:
Relationship Management - with internal and external business partners. Ensuring that our customers have the highest level of support possible to resolve issues as quickly and as completely as possible.

Project Management - including helping to drive the best UX, CX and EX possible in projects that are aligned to my business vertical. 

Data Analysis, Mining and Reporting. In this role I help to define emerging patterns which may impact customer experience by analyzing data which is collected through the various methods available.

Developing new and refining existing training, knowledge management and procedures to decrease time of resolution for escalated tickets, resulting in a higher quality customer service experience. 

Tactical Response Team management including 24/7 pager support. Responsibilities include ensuring appropriate communication is distributed for customer impact to all customer facing teams, coordinating with customers to ensure impact is resolved.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: This team is part of the business operations group that is responsible for supporting authorization services. We utilize leadership, process management, analytics and reverse engineering of code to provide solutions to real time complications. Another emphasis of the team is to champion change and to design preventative measures to protect platforms and ensure stability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer, BPMS (Business Process Management System) using Pega. There are many applications that we develop under the umbrella of BPMS and we integrate with nearly every core system in MasterCard. 

My responsibilities can include but are not limited to Business Analyst, Software Developer, Tech Lead, Project Management and Production Support.

positions.title: Software Application Engineer
positions.description: Software Application Engineer - Focused on the Enterprise Data Warehouse. Teradata development using SQL stored procedures, macros and queries. ETL developement using Informatica with XML and PowerCenter 9. Including code deployments.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description: Software development using CFMC. Part of a team that works together to insure full client satisfaction with a custom product made specific to the clients specifications. Work closely with the rest of the team to insure longevity with our customers, repeat business and further business opportunities.

positions.title: Assistant General Manager
positions.description: Assistant in running all operations of the store. My responsibilities included but were not limited to: sales, deliveries, inventory control, customer service, opening and closing the store.

positions.title: Purchasing Agent
positions.description:
Data Entry, lowering costs through research of better products, office administration, time card tracking system.

Lowered cost by $248,000+ a year within the first few months of my leadership as a purchasing professional at John Ramming.

positions.title: Office Administrator
positions.description: Office Administration including documentation filing, creating and publishing promotional material, travel planning, credit checking, data entry, collections and screening phone calls.

positions.title: Q&A
positions.description: Created web based training for new employees. Creation of manuals for benefits departments of new clients. Quality control of policies that would be sent to the clients.

positions.title: Teller - Part Time
positions.description: Cash Balancing, Customer Service, Sales and Closing the branch.

positions.title: Account Manager
positions.description: Responsible for cost reconciliation regarding bad checks. Team Leader responsibilities included working with the team to speed up and increase efficiency. Working directly with branch managers to ensure the appropriate parties were charged for bad transactions.
